system.description:
Druids who have walked close to the boundary between divine and arcane magic. They don't cross it, but they stand at the edge and look over.

  • Verdant Power: when you cast a damaging spell, add your Wisdom modifier as bonus damage to one target.
    • 9th level: to two targets.
  • Deep Roots: Advantage on checks to identify, counter or dispel magic in natural places, and a caster of lower level than you has Disadvantage on checks to counter or dispel your spells in natural terrain.
